# `arch/include/arch/platform.h`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Board bring-up hooks the kernel calls during early boot.

```c
#include <arch/platform.h>
```

## Functions

### `ArchPlatformInitDevices` { #archplatforminitdevices }

```c
void ArchPlatformInitDevices(void);
```

Probes and starts the board's devices from the device tree.

### `ArchEarlyPutc` { #archearlyputc }

```c
void ArchEarlyPutc(char c);
```

Writes one character to the boot UART by polling, before any console driver runs.

A '
' is sent as "\r\n".

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `c` | in | Character to write. |
